compatible.label: Compatible with every major BIM authoring tool

featuresSection.label: FEATURES
featuresSection.title: View, validate, measure, and edit IFC
featuresSection.subtitle: Every tool your team reaches for before an IFC delivery. Private, fast, free.

features.title: 18-rule IFC validator
features.body: Catch GUID duplicates, spatial hierarchy violations, and orphan elements before your client does. Every model receives a Health Score from 0 to 100. Results stream in real time from a background worker — UI stays fully responsive.

features.title: Multi-model support
features.body: Load multiple IFC files simultaneously. Independent visibility, transforms, validation, quantity takeoff, and export per model. Manage everything from the Scene panel.

features.title: Drag & drop, no upload
features.body: Open any .ifc file instantly. Parsed client-side via web-ifc WebAssembly — your data never leaves the browser. No account, no server, works fully offline.

features.title: OPFS geometry cache
features.body: Parsed geometry is stored in the browser's Origin Private File System. Repeat loads are ~10× faster with no re-parsing — and it works completely offline.

features.title: Non-destructive editing
features.body: Fix what the validator finds — without touching the original file. Edit GlobalIds, names, and property set values inline with full undo/redo history.

features.title: Quantity takeoff
features.body: Reads IfcElementQuantity data to aggregate area, volume, and length per IFC class. Per-model results update in real time as you load or filter models.

features.title: Measurement tools
features.body: Measure length, area, volume, and edge dimensions directly in the 3D viewport. Results persist as labelled annotations and export alongside your model.

features.title: Floor plans & section cuts
features.body: Generate accurate 2D floor plan views from any storey. Cut live section planes at any angle or axis to inspect internal structure without hiding geometry.

features.title: IFC + GLB export
features.body: Export the corrected IFC binary (all diffs applied in a Web Worker) or export visible geometry as a standard GLB file. Multi-model batch export supported.

features.title: IFC2x3, IFC4, IFC4x1, IFC4x3
features.body: All current IFC schema versions supported — Revit, ArchiCAD, Tekla, Allplan, Vectorworks, BricsCAD BIM and more. Outdated schemas are flagged by the validator.

features.title: Postproduction renderer
features.body: Toggle SSAO (ambient occlusion), edge rendering, and bloom postprocessing for presentation-quality stills — no external render farm needed.

features.title: IfcRelationsIndexer
features.body: Every relationship in the model is pre-indexed on load. Near-instant lookup for spatial containment, classification trees, type assignments, and element properties.

howItWorksSection.label: HOW IT WORKS
howItWorksSection.title: From file to validated, measured model

steps.title: Open your IFC
steps.body: Drag & drop or click to open any IFC file. web-ifc WebAssembly parses it entirely in your browser — no upload, no network required. OPFS caches geometry for instant repeat loads.

steps.title: Inspect & validate
steps.body: Explore the model tree, filter by category, and run 18 built-in validation rules in a background worker. Duplicate GUIDs, spatial hierarchy errors, missing type assignments — all flagged instantly.

steps.title: Edit & measure
steps.body: Fix GUIDs with one click. Edit names and property values inline with full undo/redo. Measure lengths, areas, and volumes in 3D. View 2D floor plans and cut live section planes.

steps.title: Visualise & export
steps.body: Toggle SSAO, edge rendering, and bloom for presentation renders. Export the corrected IFC binary (all diffs applied server-free) or visible geometry as a standard GLB.

faq.q: Is my IFC file uploaded anywhere?
faq.a: No. Files are parsed entirely in your browser via web-ifc, a WebAssembly build of the open-source IFC parser. Nothing leaves your machine. The app works completely offline once loaded.

faq.q: Can I use it with confidential models under NDA?
faq.a: Yes. Because all processing happens in your browser and no data is ever transmitted to any server, you can safely use it with confidential project models under NDA. There is no service agreement to review with your client — no data changes hands.

faq.q: Can I share the validation results with my team or client?
faq.a: Yes. After running validation, export your results as JSON, CSV, or a signed Validation Certificate — then share with your team or client. A shareable URL that encodes the full Health Score and issue list directly in a link (no file needed) is on the roadmap. The IFC file itself never leaves your browser.
Yes, fully. IFC Viewer Online works on any modern browser — Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Safari on both Mac and Windows. No plugin, no installation, no operating system restriction.

faq.q: What happens if my IFC file is very large?
faq.a: The app handles files up to 2 GB. Performance depends on your device — files under 200 MB load well on most modern hardware. Once parsed, geometry is cached in OPFS so every subsequent load of the same file is instant, even offline.

The validator runs 18 built-in rules in a background Web Worker so the UI stays responsive. Rules cover GUID duplicates, spatial hierarchy, orphan elements, naming conventions, missing type assignments, clash detection, and more. Every model receives a Health Score from 0 to 100. Results stream in as each rule completes.

faq.q: Can I fix errors and re-export a corrected IFC?
faq.a: Yes. All edits (GUID fixes, renames, property value changes) are held as non-destructive diffs with full undo/redo. Clicking Export IFC applies all diffs to the original binary in a Web Worker and downloads the corrected file — no server involved.

IFC2x3, IFC4, IFC4x1, and IFC4x3. The viewer uses the open-source web-ifc parser — the same engine used by most modern BIM tools and @thatopen/components. Outdated schemas are automatically flagged by the validator.

You can measure lengths between any two points, areas of surfaces, volumes of enclosed elements, and individual edge lengths — all directly in the 3D viewport. Measurements persist as labelled annotations and can be exported alongside your model.

faq.q: Can I view floor plans and cut sections?
faq.a: Yes. Floor plan mode generates accurate 2D orthographic views from any IfcBuildingStorey in the model. Section cuts let you define clipping planes at any position and angle to inspect internal structure without hiding geometry.

faq.q: Can I load multiple IFC files at once?
faq.a: Yes. Load as many IFC files as your device memory allows. Each model has independent visibility, transforms, validation, quantity takeoff, and export. Use the Scene panel to manage, reorder, or remove models at any time.
Yes, once the page is loaded. The WebAssembly parser and WebGL renderer run entirely in the browser. Parsed geometry is cached in OPFS so repeat loads are instant even without a network connection.

faq.q: What are the file size limits?
faq.a: There is no enforced limit — performance depends on your device. Files up to ~200 MB typically load well on modern hardware. The OPFS geometry cache means you only pay the parse cost once per file.

faq.q: Is it free? Can I use it for commercial projects?
faq.a: Yes, completely free. The source code is MIT-licensed. You can use the live app or fork the repository for your own projects, including commercial ones.
